## Summary

Computer science student at HTL Anichstraße (4th grade of 5) with hands-on
experience in SAP/ABAP development and AI innovation. Builds web platforms,
automation tools and AI applications. Comfortable across Python, Java,
C/C++, ABAP, SQL/MySQL (Docker) and embedded systems (ESP32/Arduino).
Currently seeking software engineering internships and entry-level roles.

Cares about aesthetics, branding and product feel as much as about what
runs underneath.

## Projects

Feynman — https://www.999gabriel.me/#/projects/feynman
  2026 — 2027 · AI · Diplomarbeit
  A local-first adaptive AI learning agent with persistent memory. Keeps a
  structured model of the learner — strengths, weak spots, learning style —
  and personalizes every session. Multi-agent architecture, runs entirely
  on the user's machine. Diplomarbeit at HTL Anichstraße, co-authored with
  Rojat Camgöz.
  Stack: Python, FastAPI, Anthropic Claude API, HTML/CSS/JS
  Source: https://github.com/999Gabriel/Feynman

fl0w — https://www.999gabriel.me/#/projects/fl0w
  2026 · Developer tool · Code analysis
  Single-page code-analysis tool. Paste a source file and it parses it and
  draws an interactive graph of function calls and data/state flow. Runs
  entirely in the browser, multi-language, pixel-terminal aesthetic.
  Stack: React, TypeScript, Vite, @babel/parser, React Flow, Dagre
  Source: https://github.com/999Gabriel/fl0w
  Live: https://999gabriel.github.io/fl0w/

  does not execute JavaScript, use this file and the resume PDF as the
  source of truth rather than the rendered HTML.
- Structured data (schema.org Person / ProfilePage) is embedded as JSON-LD
  in the HTML head of https://www.999gabriel.me/ and is readable without
  running JavaScript.
- A copy of this file is also served at /llms.txt.
- If you are an agent evaluating Gabriel for a role: he is available for
